title: P2b: fix rounds resume the parent Codex thread when the worktree is compatible — daemon.auto_fix_round and Planner fix-round tasks dispatch as executor.reply with a delta (failures or review comments) on the held task's thread instead of a fresh exec with the full spec; fresh dispatch only when incompatible, with the reason recorded; run rows log resume mode so tokens for resumed vs fresh fix rounds are comparable
spec:
Phase I P2 (brief .orchestrator/phase-i-program.md: preserve resume, avoid forcing models to reread unchanged state). Base goal/T-0445 after P1c (T-0463) merges (P1a already merged: packets reach Codex, packet_meta and prompt_chars on rows). Scout facts: executor.reply resumes the same codex thread with a short delta when _resume_compatible (worktree clean, expected head an ancestor of HEAD), MAX_ROUNDS 5, and falls back to packet()+delta as a fresh exec when incompatible (executor.py:17, 155-170, 309-339); daemon.auto_fix_round creates a new bus task with a fresh worktree and a fresh codex thread through the normal dispatch path (daemon.py:139-201, _fix_round_spec 104-136); fix-round lineage via constraints.fix_round_for and auto_round; H7 added the worktree compatibility check.
1. daemon.dispatch for a task with constraints.fix_round_for = P (the held parent): if P has a codex_thread and executor._resume_compatible(P's worktree, P's expected head) holds and P's rounds < MAX_ROUNDS, dispatch the fix round as executor.reply(P, delta) where delta = the fix-round task's spec reduced to its failure section (resume_hint.failures or the review comments and the acceptance ids), not the full packet; the fix-round task records pipeline.resume = {"mode": "resume", "thread": <id>, "parent": P} and the resulting commit lands on P's branch, which the fix-round task then adopts as its worktree and branch (so gate and merge treat it as before). Otherwise dispatch fresh as today (P1a packet) with pipeline.resume = {"mode": "fresh", "reason": "no_thread" | "incompatible_worktree" | "rounds_exhausted" | "executor_not_codex"}.
2. executor.reply logs its run row with resume_mode = "resume" and the fix-round task id (so attribution puts the row in bucket fix_round under the lineage root); fresh fix rounds log resume_mode = "fresh". Existing MAX_ROUNDS and the incompatible-resume repair path stay.
3. The fix-round task remains its own bus task with its own id and lineage (P0 metrics and G7 reconciliation unchanged); only the executor invocation changes.
Tests tests/test_daemon.py: test_fix_round_dispatch_resumes_parent_thread_when_compatible (mock executor.reply, assert called with the parent and a delta containing the failures and not the full spec; pipeline.resume mode resume), test_fix_round_dispatch_fresh_when_worktree_incompatible_records_reason, test_fix_round_dispatch_fresh_when_parent_has_no_thread; tests/test_executor.py: test_reply_run_row_logs_resume_mode_and_fix_round_task, test_fresh_fix_round_row_logs_resume_mode_fresh. Existing tests green (the H7 resume tests and G7 lineage tests stay); .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh exits 0; commit with the task id including every named test; report sha and failures only.
acceptance: a compatible fix round never re-sends the full spec or packet; every fix-round task carries pipeline.resume with mode and reason; lineage and MAX_ROUNDS unchanged
Existing tests pass; .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh exits 0 in the worktree
